subject: 梓潼李业阙现存单阙南面（阙顶为后世补配）
caption: 李业阙 · 现存单阙南面
东汉初年阙身，阙顶为后配
author: Nekitarc（CrB_Nekit）
source_note: 已查看 Nekitarc 2015 年正面实照，原构现存单石阙身及基石，照片中帽状阙顶为后世补配。保留真实后配帽顶并明确说明，不复原失去的汉代上部或另一阙；省略现代保护亭、邻碑和全部文字。图像为AI线描转绘。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line heritage illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: a verified frontal photograph of the surviving Li Ye Que 李业阙 in Changqing, Zitong, Sichuan.
Draw exactly ONE existing stone que as photographed: a tall tapering rectangular monolithic shaft, wider at its worn foot and slightly narrower at the top, on its low square stone base; retain the existing low projecting cap with curled ends and small central round ornament exactly as visible. This cap is a later addition, not a surviving Han roof. Do not invent or reconstruct any missing ancient storeys, brackets, side tower or twin pillar. Keep the photograph's worn edges, small base breaks, sparse shallow carved framing curves near top and bottom. Remove ALL inscriptions including the eight large central characters and lower dense text; leave those faces white rather than adding substitute marks.
Create refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing, confident very fine contours and a few even finer internal structural lines. All surfaces WHITE. No dark fills, no grey shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, no stone texture, no stippling. Do not copy photo color or surface mottling.
Portrait 1024×1536, complete single que centered occupying about 82% height. Front view, verticals vertical, only very slight side depth. Show entire cap and low base with ample white margins. Remove the modern protective pavilion, ceiling, posts, lattice windows, neighbouring stelae, shrubs and ground paving. Only a few short ground lines. No labels, letters, calligraphy, captions, dimension lines, watermark, frame, border or color.

site_recommendation.name: 李业阙
site_recommendation.place: 四川 · 绵阳 · 梓潼
site_recommendation.lede: 长卿山麓一段收分的石阙身，承载着关于李业的记忆。古阙现仅存一座，所见阙顶为后世补配。
facts: 一般系于东汉初年，传统断代为建武十二年（36）；此处以约年登记，不把后配阙顶计为汉代原构。
现存单体石阙，阙身约高2.45米；正南面原有题铭和清代《移阙记》，其余三面素面。
清道光二十五年（1845），知县周树棠发现残阙身并移置李节士祠保护；图版按现存形态绘制。
